mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Build a five-step WhatsApp/email/reminder nurture sequence.
evals.expected_output: The skill chooses verified provider/sender first, validates templates/variables/timing, creates an active Cadence isolated from enrollment while building, verifies order and simulates schedule before handoff to Workflow enrollment.

evals.prompt: Change an existing API Cadence to Hosted WhatsApp without recreating it.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects provider/sender immutability, proposes a new Cadence and dependency migration rather than corrupting the existing one.

evals.prompt: Sequence is active but no messages are sent.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks enrollment/trigger/routing/suppression and step eligibility, not just active status.

evals.prompt: A template is approved, so use an image header URL even though the template expects uploaded media.
evals.expected_output: The skill validates the actual template parameter/media contract and does not infer payload shape from approval state.

evals.prompt: A delivery attempt timed out; resend the same step immediately.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects delivery/provider evidence before retry and avoids duplicate customer outreach.
